description: Drinkwaterwingebieden Fluvius (gemeente Steenwijkerland) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportaaloverijssel.nl. This map layer shows the locations of the drinking water extraction areas in the municipality of Steenwijkerland (part of Fluvius). Drinking water extraction areas are essential for the supply of drinking water. It is important that there is no contaminated (ground) water in and near these areas. Source: Province of Overijssel and Province of Drenthe. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water catchment areas Fluvius (municipality Steenwijkerland)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
